This role supports a national, highly distributed environment across branch locations, manufacturing facilities, corporate offices, and data centers. Strong communication skills and executive presence. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in a related field. Experience supporting highly distributed organizations, including manufacturing, distribution, retail, field services, or similar environments. The Sr. Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment, modernization, and ongoing support of software applications used globally in GM manufacturing plants. This role will help deconstruct existing deployment processes and make them AI-centric, improving speed, repeatability, reliability, and business engagement across GM’s manufacturing footprint. In this role, you will work hands-on to build full-stack application environments based on detailed requirements and system specifications. Deployment activities will include gathering requirements from manufacturing plants, updating existing software installations, configuring applications for plant-specific needs, testing and troubleshooting application or plant-configuration issues, and developing automation for repeatable deployment activities. The role will apply generative AI to automate PLC and SCADA script generation, develop predictive maintenance analytics, and enable natural-language query interfaces for plant-floor data while preserving the reliability and operational stability required in manufacturing environments. This role requires a strong development background to build new capabilities, process automation, test automation, and AI-enabled deployment workflows. The engineer will identify and implement responsible AI solutions, contribute to security lifecycle maintenance, ensure that third-party applications and operating systems comply with the GM IT statement of technical direction, and partner with development and support teams to maintain uptime, reliability, security, and operational readiness. Work closely with IT infrastructure delivery teams to install and configure virtual servers in plant data centers with minimum supervision. Establish appropriate validation, testing, human review, security, and traceability practices for AI-generated scripts, configurations, and recommendations. Work with in-plant resources to validate application functionality, data quality, and integration with physical systems. Provide analysis and site-specific business configuration required to meet launch and deployment initiatives. Support GE Digital CIMPLICITY, OPC UA/DA, PLC-to-MES integrations, Kepware connectivity, and related manufacturing data flows. Investigate IT system integration problems and provide technical input for problem resolution. Develop and maintain software, deployment automation, test automation, and supporting tools using appropriate engineering practices. Monitor application uptime, performance, data quality, and AI solution effectiveness; identify and remediate reliability issues. Maintain technical documentation to reflect accurate and current production installations, deployment procedures, integrations, and AI model or prompt behavior. Review pull requests and collaborate with developers on user stories, test cases, code quality, and production readiness. Actively engage in development-team activities associated with brainstorming new solutions and refining current solutions. Drive technical efforts that lead to successful software project delivery and measurable improvements in deployment efficiency. Possess technical depth and applied experience in multi-layer solutioning, performance tuning, solution debugging, incident triage and remediation, and usability improvement. Travel to physical plant locations for workshops, discovery, testing, and deployment activities. Work during manufacturing plant downtime, which may include weekends, second shift, third shift, and holidays. Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining control-room or manufacturing applications on shop-floor IT infrastructure. Experience with industrial protocols, PLCs, manufacturing equipment, and plant-floor data collection and integration. Experience designing, integrating, or operationalizing AI/ML solutions in an enterprise or manufacturing environment. Experience with generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, or AI-assisted software and script development. Experience developing or applying predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, forecasting, or other manufacturing analytics models. Experience creating natural-language query or conversational interfaces for operational, manufacturing, or time-series data. Experience implementing safeguards for AI solutions, including validation, access control, data protection, explainability, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop review. Databases: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or comparable relational and time-series data technologies. Web Application Servers: Tomcat, IIS, or comparable platforms. Infrastructure: Server provisioning, virtual machines, networking, clustered servers, and plant data-center environments. Operating systems and platforms: Linux, UNIX, Windows Server, and cloud technologies. Tools: Cursor, Confluence, ServiceNow, GitHub, Fortify, SonarLint/SonarQube, Artifactory, and JIRA. Strong .NET/C# development skills. Strong Python or PowerShell scripting skills, with the ability to build deployment, integration, and test automation. Experience with Agile teams that regularly deliver software while practicing code review and automated testing. Proven experience diagnosing issues from browser to application, infrastructure, network, database, and industrial systems. Experience with IT enterprise security concepts and implementation. Kepware experience, including configuring an IoT Gateway to allow a PLC to communicate with an upper-level application through Kepware, importing tags, and supporting automatic tag generation. People Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate and translate feedback, needs, risks, and solutions across IT, engineering, plant operations, and business stakeholders. Creative problem-solving skills that deliver elegant solutions to complex technical and operational issues. Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams. A high degree of business insight, creativity, decision-making skill, drive for results, negotiation ability, peer-relationship development, and technical learning agility. A customer-centric mindset and enthusiasm for complex systems, reliable software, responsible AI, and measurable business outcomes. What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) Deep experience with GE Digital CIMPLICITY (SCADA), OPC UA/DA, and PLC-to-MES data integration. Previous manufacturing, plant-floor, industrial automation, or operational technology experience. Demonstrated experience deploying AI/ML solutions into production and monitoring their performance and value. Experience with AI-assisted DevOps, MLOps, model lifecycle management, or LLMOps. Experience with time-series data, industrial historians, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, or digital twins. Experience with enterprise LLM platforms, vector databases, or retrieval-augmented generation architectures. GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc).
